input.explanation: The physical driver license card (f009:p10) clearly shows EXP 02/17/2025 and ISS 01/06/2021, confirming it is an older, limited-term card that has already expired. The MVR report (f009:p9) shows a current record issued 04/09/2025 with an expiration of 02/17/2030, reflecting a renewed/updated license. The two documents genuinely show different expiration dates (2025 vs. 2030) because the license card predates the most recent renewal captured in the MVR.
